Here are all unique non-test caller files:

RELEVANT_FILES_START
common/stats/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/common/stats/StatsFactory.java | defines the createStatsCounter() method signature — must be updated directly
common/stats/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/common/stats/DefaultStatsFactory.java | implements StatsFactory and also internally calls createStatsCounter()
common/stats/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/common/stats/FstStatsServiceImpl.java | calls statsFactory.createStatsCounter() for encode/decode counters
common/script/script-api/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/script/api/AbstractScriptInvokeService.java | calls statsFactory.createStatsCounter() for requests/responses/failures/timeouts counters
common/edqs/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/edqs/stats/DefaultEdqsStatsService.java | calls statsFactory.createStatsCounter() for EDQS counters
dao/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/util/BufferedRateExecutorStats.java | calls statsFactory.createStatsCounter() for rate executor stats
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/queue/TbCoreConsumerStats.java | calls statsFactory.createStatsCounter() for all core consumer message type counters
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/queue/TbRuleEngineConsumerStats.java | calls statsFactory.createStatsCounter() for rule engine message counters
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/queue/EdgeConsumerStats.java | calls statsFactory.createStatsCounter() for edge consumer counters
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/housekeeper/stats/HousekeeperStatsService.java | calls statsFactory.createStatsCounter() for housekeeper task type counters
RELEVANT_FILES_END
